items.title: Microsoft responds to LG monitors installing McAfee ads on Windows

items.body: The app, LG Monitor App Installer, installs itself through a Windows Update alongside monitor driver updates. LG Monitor App Installer then pushes ads for a 30-day free trial for McAfee, as well as other software, via a pop-up on affected systems, multiple users have reported. submitted by /u/miauguau44 [link] [comments]
